what: Goshains among minor landowning castes (with Lodhas, Sunars, Jats), area small but increasing
quote: Of the remaining castes the principal are the Lodhas, Goshains, Sunars and Jats, but the area held by them is still very small, though increasing

what: Shikohabad passed in succession to Marathas, Jats, Rohillas, Himmat Goshain and the Oudh Nawab (Himmat Goshain = Himmat Bahadur Gosain, Nagas leader; order not stated here)
quote: Shikohabad fell successively under the Marathas, Jats, Rohillas, the Marathas again, Himmat Goshain and the Oudh Nawab.

what: Temple to Mahadeo, chatri and biarant under care of a Bairagi colony from very ancient times; the Bairagi Mangla built the biarant, a saint and miracle-worker
quote: At Nagla Brindaban there is a temple to Mahadeo, a chatri and a hiarantf under tho care of a Bairagi colony from yery ancient times.

what: Annual Barnath fair and well named after a Bairagi of repute for sanctity, now worshipped; offerings taken by present Bairagi Ram Das as priest
quote: Both the fair and a well in the village are named after a Bairagi of great repute for sanctity who once lived here.

what: Two sangats of Nanak Panthi faqirs with their cemetery south of the town
quote: There are also two sang its of Nanak Panthi faqira whose cemetery lies to the south of the town.
